# TestScript for 09-deep-hierarchy-context
# Asserts multi-tier command hierarchies, context ancestor accessors, and per-tier env prefixes

# 1. Full 4-tier command invocation with defaults
exec deep-hierarchy-context cluster node pod list
stdout '⚙  deep-hierarchy-context cluster node pod list'
stdout 'deep-hierarchy-context · root'
stdout 'cluster\s*$'
stdout 'node\s*$'
stdout 'list · active'
stdout '-r, --global-region\s+string\s+us-east-1\s+· default'
stdout '-c, --cluster-name\s+string\s+default-cluster\s+· default'
stdout '-n, --node-id\s+string\s+node-01\s+· default'
stdout '-w, --wait\s+time\.Duration\s+5s\s+· default'
stdout '-s, --status\s+string\s+running\s+· default'
stdout 'Full Command Path:\s+deep-hierarchy-context cluster node pod list'
stdout 'Active Leaf Name:\s+list'
stdout 'Root Global Region:\s+us-east-1'
stdout 'Ancestor Cluster:\s+default-cluster'
stdout 'Ancestor Node:\s+node-01'
stdout 'Parent Pod Wait:\s+5s'
stdout 'Leaf Status Filter:\s+running'

# 2. Overriding global flag, intermediate flags, and leaf flag
exec deep-hierarchy-context -r eu-central-1 cluster -c staging-eu node -n ingress-02 pod --wait 30s list -s pending
stdout '-r, --global-region\s+string\s+eu-central-1\s+● cli --global-region'
stdout '-c, --cluster-name\s+string\s+staging-eu\s+● cli --cluster-name'
stdout '-n, --node-id\s+string\s+ingress-02\s+● cli --node-id'
stdout '-w, --wait\s+time\.Duration\s+30s\s+● cli --wait'
stdout '-s, --status\s+string\s+pending\s+● cli --status'
stdout 'Root Global Region:\s+eu-central-1'
stdout 'Ancestor Cluster:\s+staging-eu'
stdout 'Ancestor Node:\s+ingress-02'
stdout 'Leaf Status Filter:\s+pending'

# 3. Partial path without leaf command fails
exit-status 2 deep-hierarchy-context cluster node
stderr 'Usage:'
stderr 'deep-hierarchy-context cluster node <command>'

# 4. Help screen on intermediate command cluster
exec deep-hierarchy-context cluster --help
stdout 'Usage:'
stdout 'deep-hierarchy-context cluster <command>'
stdout 'Commands:'
stdout 'node\s+Node operations'

# 5. Per-tier environment binding: cluster and node inherit the FLEET_ app
#    prefix, while the envprefix tag on the pod command scopes its whole subtree
#    (pod and pod list) to FLEET_POD_
env FLEET_GLOBAL_REGION=ap-south-1
env FLEET_CLUSTER_NAME=prod-ap
env FLEET_NODE_ID=edge-07
env FLEET_POD_WAIT=10s
env FLEET_POD_STATUS=pending
exec deep-hierarchy-context cluster node pod list
stdout '-r, --global-region\s+string\s+ap-south-1\s+● env FLEET_GLOBAL_REGION'
stdout '-c, --cluster-name\s+string\s+prod-ap\s+● env FLEET_CLUSTER_NAME'
stdout '-n, --node-id\s+string\s+edge-07\s+● env FLEET_NODE_ID'
stdout '-w, --wait\s+time\.Duration\s+10s\s+● env FLEET_POD_WAIT'
stdout '-s, --status\s+string\s+pending\s+● env FLEET_POD_STATUS'
stdout 'Root Global Region:\s+ap-south-1'
stdout 'Ancestor Cluster:\s+prod-ap'
stdout 'Ancestor Node:\s+edge-07'
stdout 'Parent Pod Wait:\s+10s'
stdout 'Leaf Status Filter:\s+pending'
